Answer: A
Reason: The chest radiograph shows a near-complete white-out of the right hemithorax with a distinct meniscus sign and contralateral (leftward) mediastinal shift, which are classic features of a massive pleural effusion pushing structures away. Other causes of white-out like atelectasis would pull the mediastinum toward the opacity, while pneumonia typically does not cause such significant mass effect.
